"""Offline NetNomos finite-domain command line."""
import ctypes
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
DEPS=Path(os.environ.get('NETNOMOS_DEPS',str(ROOT.parent/'vendor')))
if not DEPS.is_dir():
    DEPS=Path('/workspace/vendor')
libz=DEPS/'system-libs/libz.so.1'
if libz.is_file():
    ctypes.CDLL(str(libz),mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
sys.path.insert(0,str(DEPS))
from tqdm import tqdm
tqdm.monitor_interval=0
from netnomos.finite import compile_job

def main():
    batch=json.load(sys.stdin)
    json.dump({'results':[compile_job(job) for job in batch['jobs']]},sys.stdout,separators=(',',':'))
    sys.stdout.write('\n')

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
